outcome: Diagnostic sensitivity and specificity of ultrasound
Long-term visual consequences (childhood blindness, loss of visual capacity, amblypia)
cohort: Three infants diagnosed with congenital cataracts who had antenatal ultrasound examinations.
finding: There can be incongruence between antenatal ultrasound findings and postnatal results for congenital cataracts, emphasizing the importance of a targeted and thorough ultrasound survey of the orbital region at morphology scans, especially in high-risk individuals, for early and accurate diagnosis.
